name: CF1: the counterfactual fork statistic, offline (intuitive-physics-engine futures read as plan vs hold)
registered: 2026-10-25 21:05 EDT (file time), before eval/cf_fork.py has run
motivation: User 2026-10-25: keep the fork / intuitive physics engine as the core; task-agnostic; concern that a side-effect test vs the first frame breaks when the background changes. The fork's existing split / spread statistics flag >= 12% of safe-episode states at 50% recall of pre-topple states (grasp included) and do not say which branch is bad. The counterfactual reading compares the SAME 64 noisy futures under the policy's plan and under holding still, outside the plan's hand path, so only what the action changes remains (Battaglia-style 'will it fall' share, relative to doing nothing).
data: held-out paired_record_m3 decisions (z from results/jenga/hj2/data, plan16 / target from the rollout npz): all 180 decisions 1-3 chunks before a topple, all safe-episode gripper-closed decisions, 1200 other safe-episode decisions (seeded 20261026). Labels select the sample and grade only.
statistics: per scale s in {2, 4} (2 = the episodes' execution noise), 64 draws shared by both branches: d_j = q98 over outside-hand patches of mean_ch |f_plan_j - f_hold_j| at the 30-step end; o_j = same for f_plan_j vs the current latent (the fork CBF's regime-change term, as a share); e_j = f_hold_j vs the current latent (already moving under hold). For each: P = share of draws above tau (tau = q98 of the per-draw value over pre-grasp decisions, label-free), mean, max. Reference: the hold branch's spread (log principal-axis variance), the existing fork statistic.
grading: AUC (pre-topple vs safe-episode decisions) and the share of safe gripper-closed decisions flagged at the threshold that flags 50% of pre-topple decisions.
gate_CF1: PASS iff some P_d (s = 2 or 4) has AUC >= 0.85 AND flags at most half as many safe gripper-closed decisions as the better hold-spread reference at 50% recall. PASS -> pre-register a closed-loop use (CBF condition on P_d relative to hold, and/or P_d as the failure margin of the learned value). FAIL -> report; the hold-spread fork remains the trigger.
scope: task-agnostic (latent patches + the robot's own hand path from proprio and its plan), label-free statistic, off-the-shelf DINOv2 latent model_OIL; exploratory offline gate, no closed-loop claim.
